implemented_requirements.evidence: config.py defines BOARD_SIZE = 15; Board.__init__ creates a grid of size BOARD_SIZE; Board.size is set from the argument (default BOARD_SIZE).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Two players (black and white) alternate turns
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py sets current_player = PLAYER_BLACK and switches with: self.current_player = (PLAYER_WHITE if self.current_player == PLAYER_BLACK else PLAYER_BLACK) after each successful move.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Place stones only on empty intersections
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_valid_move checks bounds and that grid[row][col] == EMPTY; Board.place_stone uses this check before assigning the player id.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect a win of five consecutive stones horizontally, vertically, or diagonally
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.check_win iterates over DIRECTIONS = [(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(1,-1)], collects consecutive stones of the same player, and returns a window of five when length >=5.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect a draw when the board is full
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_full scans the grid for any EMPTY cell; GomokuGame.make_move sets game_over and winner = None when board.is_full() is true.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Maintain move history and support undo
implemented_requirements.evidence: GomokuGame.move_history records each move; undo_move pops the last entry, clears the cell, and restores the turn.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ability to restart a new game
implemented_requirements.evidence: GomokuGame.reset clears the board and reinitialises all state; GUI button "Restart" calls self.game.reset() and redraws.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Graphical display of the board and stones
implemented_requirements.evidence: gui.py creates a Tkinter Canvas, draws the grid lines in _draw_grid, and draws stones with create_oval for each non‑EMPTY cell.
In GUI.redraw, cells in self.game.get_winning_line() are drawn with an extra oval using HIGHLIGHT_COLOR.
GUI.redraw draws a small red circle (HIGHLIGHT_COLOR) at the last move when it is not part of a winning line.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Status bar showing current turn, move count, and game result
implemented_requirements.evidence: GUI._update_status sets the text of self.status_label based on game.is_game_over(), winner, and current player.

judge.summary: All core Gomoku features are present: a 15x15 board, alternating black/white turns, move validation, win/draw detection, move history with undo, restart capability, and a functional Tkinter GUI that draws the board, stones, highlights the winning line, shows the last move, and updates a status bar. The code is syntactically complete and appears ready to run, so the submission meets the benchmark.
